Name: animationPause
Desc:
Enable the animation pauser during
battle animations. Battle animations can be
paused and advanced at the player's discretion.

NOTE: This mod uses a blocking loop to force the
game to wait; until the animation is unpaused,
the game window will appear unresponsive.
Even if the game window is unfocused,
keyboard control inputs will still apply in the
animation pauser.

Keyboard Controls:
P - Pause the current battle animation.
O - Unpause the current battle animation
Down Arrow - Advance the battle animation
as long as the key is held
Up/Right Arrow - Alternate between the two keys
to advance the battle animation frame-by-frame
Left Arrow - Advance at 60 FPS
